purpose: Prevent partial cleanup families, cross-actor cues, and overactive ambient acting from re-entering the playable build.

selectiveLegacyExceptions.policy: Only the uncleaned cheeky camera grin and neutral reach may use this source, and only as sparse authored holds/contact instants.

rook.note: The newest cleaned Rook family owns every available runtime pose. The broad frames directory is barred except for the two explicit missing-cleanup exceptions.

selectiveLegacyExceptions.policy: Continuity-cleaned finite authored one-shots only. Never use as ordinary talk, ambient life, or repeating reactions.

arthur.note: Clean core owns everyday acting. The repaired glasses and camera reactions are admitted only at sparse authored beats with a deliberate return to core.

runtimeRules: A cue may render only when clip.actorId matches the receiving character slot.
Rook and Arthur positions never derive from an animation frame or speaker identity.
Ambient acting begins with a long still window and is limited to isolated blink or breath events.
The stamp sequence is up, down, up; the retired stamp-ready cel is not used.
Smirks and broad grins are silent expressions, never talking loops.
Rook and Arthur share the same 125ms closed/open speech cadence; mouth motion ends before the bubble reading hold.
Continuity-cleaned camera or glasses art may appear only through the named finite exception clips; all other partial cleanup art remains review history.
